data.title: 菲奥娜 · 寒夜天台的静默监视
data.description: 【菲奥娜 · 寒夜天台的静默监视】冬夜冷风呼啸的高耸钟楼天台之上，菲奥娜身披深蓝厚大衣隐匿于背光的阴影中。她戴着棕色皮质手套双手稳定托举战术双筒望远镜，镜头锁向远处街角亮着橘暖微光的福杰家公寓。风吹乱了她额前垂落的发丝，她如同雕塑般在零下风雪中静止伫立，无怨无悔地在暗夜中担任守护者。
data.action: 双手持战术望远镜俯瞰夜市与公寓
data.lighting: 冷冽月光与远方城市微光
data.promptProse: On a winter clocktower rooftop, Fiona holds tactical binoculars steadily in both gloved hands, watching the warmly lit Forger apartment at a distant street corner. Her thick navy WISE coat shelters her still figure in the cowboy view. Wind-blown snow crosses the roof edge before receding city blocks. Cold moonlight traces her hair and binocular rims, while distant window glow stays small against the darker foreground masonry.
